text:
elin_cs: Quick huddle for Aegis Labs priv cutover. Post-smoke summary: audit delivery failing, runtime can't decrypt artifact keys intermittently, and service-account role missing sts:AssumeRole in trust. Need to triage blockers before cutover window.
tom_infra: I pulled the smoke logs. Audit forwarder is timing out on the handshake (401). Also see sporadic KMS errors: 'InvalidCiphertext' from runtime when decrypt called. Added logs to the shared bucket.
vera_kms: KMS check: customer created key but the alias isn't what our runtime expects. We ask for alias 'redwood/aegis-runtime' mapped to their CMK. Also policy needs to allow our runtime role to kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey.
rajesh_aegis: we created alias 'aegis-temp-key' during POC. Can switch alias. What's the exact policy you need?
vera_kms: policy example (decrypt + generate without plaintext):
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::REDFW:role/redwood-runtime"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext"],"Resource":"*"}]}
```
own_sec: for trust we require the cross-account role to have a condition on ExternalId and session duration <= 3600s. Also log AssumeRole to their audit stream. Provide sample trust doc:
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::REDFW:role/redwood-ops"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"sts:ExternalId":"aegis-xx-1234"}}}]}
```
elin_cs: action list I9m tracking: 1) Aegis map alias to 'redwood/aegis-runtime' and apply KMS policy from Vera, 2) Aegis create cross-account role with external-id provided and session <=1h, 3) update firewall egress for SIEM IPs and ensure forwarder token/role configured, 4) infra re-run audit-forwarding smoke.
rajesh_aegis: alias change scheduled in 2h. ExternalId for trust is 'aegis-0x9f' (we will post to secure S3 path). We will not grant kms:Encrypt to Redwood principal.
tom_infra: noted. After alias change, I'll update deployment manifest to reference alias arn:aws:kms:REGION:ACCOUNT:alias/redwood/aegis-runtime and trigger a targeted smoke. deploy-bot will run it.
deploy-bot: targeted smoke job 99444 queued awaiting trigger 'infra:alias-mapped'.
vera_kms: small reminder 5 tag keys with 'redwood:env=priv' and avoid immediate rotation during cutover. If rotation is scheduled, we need a fallback alias.
own_sec: also please ensure their SIEM accepts signed TLS connections from our forwarder. We require mTLS for audit ingestion; cert must be uploaded to 'aegis/forwarder/certs'.
rajesh_aegis: uploading cert bundle now, ETA 15m. ExternalId and certs will be in aegis/handshake tonight.
elin_cs: timeline check 5 if alias mapping and cert upload complete within today9s window, we try cutover tomorrow morning. If either slips beyond 48h, I mark renewal risk as 'elevated' and loop in Natalie.
rajesh_aegis: understood. We'll prioritize alias and certs.
elin_cs: thanks everyone. I'll open a confluence checklist and ping once job 99444 completes. Attachments: logs -> s3://aegis-handshake/logs/5112345678/ ; smoke results will post to the job link.
deploy-bot: job 99444 triggered by infra; running now.
deploy-bot: job 99444 complete 5 audit-forwarding succeeded, KMS decrypt still showing 1 intermittent failure (investigating request pattern).
tom_infra: the intermittent decrypt failure correlates with requests hitting a blue instance that still referenced the old alias. Rolling restart to pick up manifest.
rajesh_aegis: restart done. Will monitor for 30m and report.
elin_cs: final note 5 if all clear after monitoring, we set onboarding status to 'ready-for-cutover' and clear the conditional renewal flag. If issues persist >24h, we escalate to AM. :white_check_mark:
